result.title: Dissecting Geometric Constraints in Grokking: Interaction-Dependent Acceleration in Modular Arithmetic
result.summary: Spherical transformer configurations can accelerate grokking through simultaneous modifications of several model properties. The present study investigated the contributions of these modifications in the published Sphere+Fourier configuration using 960 controlled modular-arithmetic runs. A complete factorial analysis varied residual projection, readout weight normalization, logit scale, and weight decay. Across four matched settings with weight decay, the successful-run mean crossing times without projection were 8-37 times those observed with projection. However, residual projection was insufficient to induce grokking without additional interventions. Various other unprojected configurations also generalized. Since projection altered the magnitude entering the readout, these comparisons could not separate geometry from output scale. A separate 100-run fixed-horizon study demonstrated faster first crossing for the complete configuration across five train/test partitions. Faster crossing did not necessarily correspond to greater persistence over extended training. Control experiments demonstrated rapid grokking without Fourier initialization. Task and depth sweeps also identified conditions in which the configuration failed to reach the criterion by 50K epochs. Accordingly, the observed acceleration depended on interactions among the components and did not extend uniformly across the tested tasks or depths.

AI.brief_summary: 论文以 960 组受控模算术实验做全因子分析，拆解球形 Transformer 配置中残差投影、读出权重归一化、logit 尺度与权重衰减各自的作用，发现加速 grokking 依赖组件交互，且投影本身不足以诱发泛化，并报告了任务与深度扫描下的失效条件。
AI.relevance_reason: 算法任务上的表示几何约束（球面投影）加速泛化，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的表示几何与训练期正则如何影响推理能力形成提供线索；其因子拆解与快速穿越不等于持续泛化的观察也提示需核查几何效应与输出尺度、评估时长的混淆。
